project_type: Kotlin-native Android app with Jetpack Compose, Material3, Supabase backend
build_system: Gradle with Kotlin DSL (AGP 8.7.2, Kotlin 2.0.21). Cannot run Gradle locally due to sandbox network restrictions. CI runs on GitHub Actions.
test_framework: JUnit4 + AndroidJUnit4 + Compose UI testing (minimal tests currently)
build_command: Cannot run locally - validate via code inspection only
test_command: Cannot run locally - validate via code inspection only
verification_instructions: 1. Verify all Kotlin files compile cleanly by checking imports, types, and API usage match existing patterns. 2. Ensure no unresolved references. 3. NavGraph routes are properly wired. 4. All @Serializable data classes match Supabase table schema. 5. Push to Rexo-Kotlin branch - CI will build.
setup_instructions: N/A - cannot build locally. CI handles build.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Cannot install packages, run Gradle, or pull images. Must validate correctness by code inspection. GitHub push is available. CI builds on push to Rexo-Kotlin.
contribution_requirements: Push to origin Rexo-Kotlin branch. Build must pass CI (./gradlew assembleDebug). No external library additions beyond what already exists in build.gradle.kts.
key_patterns: 1. Screens in ui/screens/{feature}/ with @Composable functions. 2. ViewModels in ui/viewmodel/ extending ViewModel with StateFlow. 3. Repositories in data/repository/ using SupabaseClient singleton. 4. DTOs are @Serializable data classes with snake_case matching Supabase columns. 5. Clean white UI with RexoColors.AccentOrange accent. 6. GlassSurface/FloatingGlassCard components for cards. 7. NavGraph.kt has all routes and Screen sealed class. 8. Admin check via AuthViewModel.isAdmin StateFlow. 9. All Supabase calls use SupabaseClient.client.from(table).select/insert/update/delete patterns. 10. Loading/error/empty states required on all screens.
directory_structure: app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ - root package. ui/screens/{feature}/ - screen composables. ui/viewmodel/ - ViewModels. ui/theme/ - Theme, Colors, Shapes, Typography. ui/components/ - reusable composables. data/model/ - Room entities and serializable models. data/repository/ - Supabase data access. data/remote/ - SupabaseClient singleton. data/local/ - Room DAOs and database. navigation/ - NavGraph with Screen sealed class and bottom nav.
